difficulty_reason: The logical predicate simultaneously tracks evaluation, resource monoid order, polymorphic relation assignments and two kinds of variables. The recursive extension requires a nested induction that first descends through type structure and then through values of contractive purely positive recursive types; the fundamental theorem transports closing substitutions through the typing derivation while preserving ordered resource multiplication. The displayed base cases, compositionality and all extension definitions are retained. This supports H2 without claiming H3 from the publication venue.
core_obligations: Retain exact typing, evaluation and resource-indexed logical predicate definitions, including ordered/unrestricted closing substitutions.
Retain the complete printed proof development: compositionality, all five shown Theorem4 induction cases and Theorems6/9 extension proofs.
Retain contractiveness, purely positive recursion and the author termination proviso, and both complete definition appendices.
